exercises.question: Which expression introduces a consequence? [¿Cuál introduce una consecuencia?]
options: por eso [therefore]
debido a [due to]
porque [because]

exercises.sentence: Hay menos agua __ ha habido una sequía.
exercises.english: There is less water because there has been a drought.
Pollution has increased; therefore, we must act.

sentences: Ha habido una sequía. [There has been a drought.]
Hay menos agua. [There is less water.]
Por eso, debemos reducir el consumo. [Therefore, we must reduce consumption.]

exercises.question: Which expression introduces a cause? [¿Cuál introduce una causa?]
options: debido a [due to]
por eso [therefore]
como consecuencia [as a consequence]

exercises.sentence: __ la sequía, el nivel del río ha bajado.
exercises.english: Due to the drought, the river level has fallen.
As a consequence, some species have disappeared.

exercises.sentence: Hay menos agua porque ha habido una sequía.
options: There is less water because there has been a drought.
There is more water because there was rain.
There is less pollution because of a river.

exercises.sentence: La contaminación ha aumentado; por eso, debemos actuar.
options: Pollution has increased; therefore, we must act.
Pollution has decreased; therefore, we should wait.
Pollution has disappeared.

exercises.sentence: Debido a la sequía, el nivel del río ha bajado.
exercises.english: Due to the drought, the river level has fallen.

exercises.sentence: Como consecuencia, algunas especies han desaparecido.
options: As a consequence, some species have disappeared.
As a cause, more species arrived.
As a consequence, the river became larger.
Porque ha habido una sequía. [Because there has been a drought.]
Por eso ha habido una sequía. [Therefore there has been a drought.]
Como consecuencia ha habido una sequía. [As a consequence there has been a drought.]
Algunas especies han desaparecido. [Some species have disappeared.]
Algunas especies han desaparecidas. [Some species have disappeared (feminine plural).]
Algunas especies hayan desaparecido. [Some species have (subjunctive) disappeared.]
La contaminación ha causado parte del problema. [Pollution has caused part of the problem.]
La contaminación ha causada parte del problema. [Pollution has caused (feminine) part of the problem.]
La contaminación haya causado parte del problema. [Pollution has (subjunctive) caused part of the problem.]

template.prompt: Explain one environmental problem and its cause.
template.answer: Hay menos agua porque ha habido una sequía.

template.prompt: Explain a cause and consequence using two connectors.
template.answer: Debido a la contaminación, algunas especies han desaparecido y, por eso, debemos actuar.
